title: Grilled Teriyaki Tofu Skewers
description: A Japanese-inspired vegetarian dish featuring marinated tofu and vegetables grilled to perfection. Serve with steamed rice for a delightful meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and grated ginger.
Add the pressed tofu to the marinade and mix well.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated tofu, bell peppers, onions, and green onions onto the bamboo skewers.
Brush the grill with coconut oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with steamed rice and your favorite Japanese-inspired sides.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
